lines.text: What if building outbound automation — was as simple as describing it?
Most SDR tools are black boxes. — You rent access. — You don't own your workflows.
Prospect PAL is different. — Describe your campaign in plain English — and PAL compiles it into a real workflow you own.
Nine deterministic nodes. — Intake to enrollment. — Your keys. Your instance.
Deploy, don't rent. — Keys stay local. — Unlimited campaigns.
